content:
Mob Component

Core mob behavior component providing health, damage, and basic mob properties.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "mobComponent": {
    "health": 100,
    "damage": 10,
    "invincibilityTime": 0.5,
    "knockbackForce": 5.0
  }
}

Description

The Mob Component is the core mob behavior component that provides health, damage, and basic mob properties. It defines fundamental attributes shared by all mob entities in the game.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
healthintThe mob's health points.
damageintThe base damage dealt by the mob.
invincibilityTimefloatDuration in seconds the mob is invincible after taking damage.
knockbackForcefloatForce applied when the mob is knocked back.

Example

JSON
{
  "mobComponent": {
    "health": 50,
    "damage": 15,
    "invincibilityTime": 0.3,
    "knockbackForce": 8.0
  }
}
